exitCodes.3: human-required: a decide verb ran without a satisfied human gate
exitCodes.5: conflict: a stale revision, digest or a second owner

codes.meaning: The command line is malformed or names no verb.
The named object does not exist.
The caller may not do this, such as an admin action on the agent socket.
A decide verb needs a person at the terminal. Nothing changed.
The person's confirmation did not match. Nothing changed.
The confirmation or challenge timed out. Nothing changed.
The product's owner process is not running and could not be started.
Another owner already holds the control lock.
The digest does not match what would be decided.
This platform or tier is not supported.

productCodes.rule: A product adds codes only under its own prefix, such as ghostget.policy-locked. The registry rejects any other code that is not listed above.
